title: Crispy Fried Chicken Matching Theorem
description: A galaxy well today is the cosmic background at (1+z)^3 = delta: a matching theorem for dark sectors, and what it forces. Every relativistic completion of Milgromian dynamics that fits the cosmic microwave background carries a dark component, and in the modern completions that component is a field: the pressureless excitation of a scalar clock at the minimum of its potential. We prove a theorem about that entire class. Because the excitation is a conserved charge that dilutes as a^-3, and because a static well fixes the same excitation through the lapse, u = -Q_0 Psi, a galaxy well with dust overdensity delta is identically the cosmic background at redshift (1+z_match)^3 = delta, with the same sound speed, for any potential K. The Lyman-alpha forest at z ~ 3 therefore measures the dust inside galaxies today, and finds it cold. In the static limit the same field is a gamma = 2 polytrope, p_d = (2 pi G/mu^2) rho_d^2, c_s^2 = |Psi| c^2, whose hydrostatics is the Helmholtz equation of the Aether-Scalar-Tensor theory; on the background it pins that theory's free DBI amplitude, Lambda_D/Q_0 = nu_0 Omega_Lambda/Omega_dm, 18-300 times above its own power-spectrum ceiling. Two further results close the alternatives: an elliptic auxiliary that enters the lapse equation frees exactly one dust-like scalar, A = c_alpha^2 a^3/[4 H^2 (k^2/a^2 + m^2)], so a constraint-only two-degree-of-freedom metric MOND that light and matter both see does not exist at quadratic order; and any medium that holds itself up in a well has signal speed ~ v_c, so it cannot track a cluster merger, which the Bullet cluster requires. What survives is a dark component that is cold, ballistic and galaxy-clustering, and a MOND well accretes it: put into the theory's own lensing, the accreted charge multiplies the 100 kpc - 1 Mpc galaxy-galaxy lensing signal by 3-20 at realistic environments, which the KiDS-1000 isolated-lens relation excludes at Delta chi^2 >= 100. The positive result on the galactic side is that the per-galaxy acceleration scale across 147 SPARC rotation curves has zero intrinsic spread and no mass trend, where a plain halo population predicts both, and the acceleration scale a_0 = (c/2) sqrt(G rho_DE(z)) cannot rise with redshift, which the emergent scale of cold-dark-matter halos does. Every claim is a committed script with checks that can fail, a mutation control, and both footings of a_0.
notes: The title is the working name of the programme's relativistic-completion effort (the 'fried chicken' gates); the theorem is stated in Section 3. A theorem paper, not a discovery paper: kappa = 1/2 is fitted, never asserted derived. Fourteen committed scripts with checks that can fail, both a0 footings, loose ends of every yardstick, and three corrections made in the open and recorded in the repository ledger (a per-mode linear boost model withdrawn; a dwarf-galaxy exclusion that had used LCDM's abundance-matching ratio downgraded to marginal when redone with the framework's own gravity; an overstatement that a0 'cannot rise' replaced by the precise statement). All quantitative claims reproducible from https://github.com/carlzimmerman/zimmerman-formula (qwen_claude_field_theory/closure_2026/condensate_pincer_2026/ and prep_2026/rar_origin_2026/, all scripts exit 0). Companion to DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22242701 (v2 22254075) and DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22253953 (v2 22255522).
